_description: Character template — one file per player

preferences._description: Player preferences (meta / out-of-fiction) specific to THIS player. Recorded when the player expresses one ("remember that I like X") and re-injected to the GM at each turn to adapt the experience. Free-form but structured: keys documented below + a "custom" object for the rest. Private to the player (same per-player isolation as the sheet). All optional — an empty/missing block changes nothing (fail-open).
